title: Prove the uniform nine-call minimum for three negative Q8 targets
body:
## Summary

Prove a sign-sensitive scalar-core bound for all-negative formal Q8 endpoints and close PR3517/PR3525's seven-call handoff.

```text
A(I+H)A=0, with H strictly triangular
  gives 2 rank(A)<=n for arbitrary finite dirty workspace
  gives exactly three core roles for a seven-call negative triple
  combines with PR3471's three-role exclusion to give minimum nine
```

The direct nine-call construction attains the bound. The new package retains exact predecessor source bytes, provenance and credit. It supplies no physical caller, complete supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3525 leaves the arbitrary-workspace minimum at seven or nine. **After:** the written degree-two coefficient proof eliminates the essential dirty blocks and proves the exact minimum is nine.
- The unchanged native implementation and a separate Hamilton implementation regenerate both complete 91,955-state balls and repeat all 5,241,435 membership candidates. Both target shapes have zero hits; the positive control has nonzero hits.
- Registered CPython3.12 replay, four optimized behavioral control groups, strict C++ diagnostics, scoped Ruff, final committed-byte/source-history checks and both actual Git-free scientific/control commands pass. Generic controls cover 1,010 words, eight direct targets, 72 deletions and 320 faithful dirty input columns.

Replay: `python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/q8-negative-core-bound`. Exact proof, source pins, result, limits and standalone commands are in the package. Credit remains with PR3517/3471/3525, Tuafo/PR2900, ywz65/PR2587, PR3487 and the retained Q8 lineage.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only a new research package is added. Scientific acceptance, physical costs and full selected-supplier replay remain separate obligations.
